```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=FALSE,warning=FALSE,message=FALSE,out.width='100%')
root<-params$project_root
m<-jsonlite::fromJSON(file.path(root,'results/tables/run_summary.json'))$outbreak
tab<-function(name)read.csv(file.path(root,'results/tables',paste0(name,'.csv')))
```

Overview
=======================================================================

Row
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Interpretation

This dashboard reproduces a **fictional training outbreak**. It does not describe actual patients. Cases with missing dates or outcomes remain included in the completeness tables. The overview covers `r m$cases` records; `r m$onset_missing` lack onset dates and `r m$outcome_missing` lack outcomes.

Row
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Epidemic characteristics

```{r overview}
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(root,'results/figures/fictional_outbreak_overview.png'),rel_path=FALSE)
```

Row
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Recorded outcomes

```{r outcomes}
knitr::kable(tab('outbreak_outcomes'),digits=1)
```

Contact links
=======================================================================

Row
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Link completeness

Of `r m$recorded_links` recorded infector links, `r m$matched_endpoint_links` have both endpoints in the cleaned line list. The remaining `r m$unmatched_endpoint_links` reference an absent identifier. Missing links are not reconstructed. The deterministic 80-case June subset displays `r m$displayed_links` internal matched links.

Row
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Provided fictional contacts

```{r contacts}
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(root,'results/figures/fictional_transmission_links.png'),rel_path=FALSE)
```
